# ruz

> Single-file Rust scripts for AI agents — write Rust like Python: one file,
> embedded dependencies, zero scaffolding. Shared dep cache, default O3,
> error messages that teach. 10–70x faster than Python on CPU-bound work.

Docs: https://ruz.spraylee.com
GitHub: https://github.com/spraylee/ruz
Skill: npx skills add spraylee/ruz

## Install

- One line (Linux/macOS, needs only `cargo` on PATH):
  `curl -fsSL https://ruz.spraylee.com/i | sh`
- Or from GitHub Release:
  `curl -fsSL https://github.com/spraylee/ruz/releases/latest/download/bootstrap.sh | sh`
- Installs a small static Rust binary (4 platform targets) to `~/.local/bin/ruz`

## Script format (RFC 3502 single-file packages)

```rust
#!/usr/bin/env cargo
---
[package]
name = "fetch"
edition = "2024"
[dependencies]
reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["blocking"] }
---
fn main() {
    let body = reqwest::blocking::get("https://httpbin.org/get").unwrap().text().unwrap();
    println!("{}", &body[..80.min(body.len())]);
}
```

Run it: `ruz run fetch.rs`
Structure: shebang → TOML front matter (`[package]` + `[dependencies]`)
between `---` fences → Rust code. One file; no Cargo.toml, no project dir,
no git init. Manifest is optional — a bare `fn main()` file works too.

## Commands

```
ruz new demo.rs        # scaffold from template
ruz run demo.rs args…  # cache hit → execve cached binary; miss → compile then run
ruz check demo.rs      # fast type/borrow check, no codegen — cheap iteration
ruz warm serde:derive reqwest:blocking regex  # pre-compile deps into cache
ruz doctor             # environment checkup (cargo / -Zscript / nightly)
ruz cache              # cache location and size
```

## How it works (v0.2.0)

- `ruz` itself is a std-only Rust static binary — no Python in the path.
- Hot `run` keys on `sha256(script bytes ‖ toolchain sidecar ‖ RUSTFLAGS ‖
  profile)`. On a hit it `execve`s the cached binary directly: **no cargo
  spawn, ~2ms p50**. Args pass through; exit code is the script's.
- Toolchain sidecar `~/.cache/ruz/toolchain.fp` stats the *real* toolchain
  binaries (rustup-layout aware, `rustup default` swaps and
  `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN` overrides change the key) — a rustc upgrade never runs
  a stale binary.
- Cache miss → package name rewritten to `ruz_<stem>_<hash12>`, then
  `cargo -Zscript build`. The shared `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` keeps reusing
  compiled deps, while two scripts both named `hello` no longer collide on
  fingerprints. Manifest-less scripts are copied verbatim (line numbers in
  rustc errors match your original file exactly).
- Manifest-less or not, the compile copy lives next to your script, so
  `include_str!` / `include!` relative paths behave as written.
- Builds default to O3 — avoids the debug-profile 10–20x performance trap.
- `ruz check` returns rustc diagnostics in ~0.2s with line numbers and fix
  suggestions; measured fix-iteration count is on par with Python.

## Launcher timings (Xeon 8255C, Linux, rustc 1.98.0, 2026-09-08)

| Stage | Wall time |
|---|---|
| First compile + run (no deps) | ~0.19s |
| Edit one line, rebuild + run | ~0.13s |
| Unchanged rerun (hot path) p50 | **1.8ms** |
| v0.1.1 unchanged rerun (was) | 71ms |

strace proof: hot path is exactly 2 execve calls (ruz → cached exe), zero
cargo spawns.

## Benchmarks (Xeon 8255C, Linux, 2026-09)

| Task | python3 | ruz (O3) | Winner |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mandelbrot pure compute | 6.92s | 0.095s | ruz 73x |
| Batch 20 HTTPS fetches | 20.0s | 5.8s | ruz 3.4x |
| 40MB text pipeline | 391ms | 130ms | ruz 3x |
| SHA-256 / AES large blocks | 57ms | 110ms | python (OpenSSL) |

Rule of thumb for agents: CPU-bound temp code → ruz; crypto on big blocks or
quick glue → Python is fine.

## Limits

- Windows not supported (design boundary, not a bug).
- All scripts share one dep cache (`ruz cache` shows it) — blow it away if a
  dependency graph ever behaves weirdly.

## For AI agents

- Install the thin-pointer skill: `npx skills add spraylee/ruz -g`
- This file is the always-fresh reference — fetch it at runtime instead of
  trusting cached instructions:
  `curl -fsSL https://ruz.spraylee.com/llms.txt`
